title: Wear Your Lunch
tagline: For the goth aunt who's really into decomposition, this maggot-infested throat necklace is a conversation starter at family reunions or when explaining your life choices to a therapist.

title: Time’s Arrow for the Terminally Late
tagline: Forget your morning coffee—this is the wake-up call you actually need. The Zelda Majora’s Mask Watch counts down to doom in real time, so you can finally stop procrastinating on that ‘someday’ project. Perfect for the chronically tardy or the apocalypse enthusiast who wants to ensure they’re fashionably late for the end of the world.

title: Billionaire's Treehouse
tagline: Because who needs a yacht when you can own a $8 million treehouse in the middle of nowhere, perfect for hosting dinner parties for your 12 closest friends and a team of bewildered architects.

title: Electric Insanity Guaranteed
tagline: For the eccentric billionaire who needs to silently speed away from their own chaotic life, this electric hypercar is a discreetly loud statement piece.

title: Medieval Office Wear
tagline: For that meeting where you need to make a statement, and also possibly deflect a sword blow from a disgruntled coworker, this chain mail necktie is oddly practical.

title: Wiener Wheels For Rent
tagline: Because your friends' bachelor party needed a 20-foot hot dog on wheels, this Airbnb rental is a thing. Now you can live inside a giant wiener, just like you always wanted.

title: Lunar Vanity on Wheels
tagline: Because your driveway was missing a $700,000 rock, now you can impress your neighbors with a glow-in-the-dark Moonfire, perfect for the night you host an astronomy-themed dinner party and need a centerpiece.

title: Kitchen on Wheels
tagline: For when your road trip cravings can't wait for a rest stop. This self-contained kitchen fits in your trunk, turning your car into a mobile diner. Perfect for the 'I need to make pasta at 2 AM in a parking lot' crowd. Just don't blame us if you get pulled over for cooking and driving.

title: Galactic Fashion Disaster (SpaceX Spacesuit)
tagline: Because your Tuesday meeting could use a spacesuit, imagine strolling in wearing this and explaining to HR why you're prepared for re-entry.

title: Buggy Chocolate Delight
tagline: For when you want to impress your date with a snack that's both romantic and potentially traumatic, try dark chocolate covered crickets. It's like a relationship test in a box.

title: Sever Ties Literally
tagline: For the commitment-phobe who wants to take it to the next level, this guillotine ring is perfect for a dramatic breakup at a medieval-themed dinner party.

title: The Vertical Hamster Wheel
tagline: For those who've mastered the art of walking on a treadmill but crave a little more... verticality. Perfect for the urban climber who wants to train for their next big ascent—like that time they tried to reach the top shelf at the grocery store. Includes safety harness, because no one wants to see you take a tumble onto your studio apartment's hardwood floors.

title: Sole Mates for Keyboards
tagline: For that one friend who types with their feet, these keyboard sandals are a must. Imagine walking into a meeting with a keyboard strapped to your toes, ready to clack away at a moment's notice.

title: Gotham's Most Expensive Lamp
tagline: For the nocturnal millionaire who needs to summon Batman to their dinner parties, this $600 Bat Signal is a must. Because what's a charcuterie board without the Dark Knight?

title: Sniff Your Socks
tagline: For when you need to analyze the funk on your gym socks, the Smelloscope is here. Because who doesn't want to scientifically prove their feet smell like rotten cheese?

title: Gaming's Secret Shame
tagline: For when you want to play Xbox in a bespoke, Italian sports car-inspired helmet, because your living room isn't embarrassing enough already.

title: Cluckin' Fireplace
tagline: Imagine setting the mood with a romantic dinner, but instead of candles, you're burning KFC-scented logs, because nothing says 'I love you' like the smell of fried chicken wafting through the air.
